YUBASE 3 is listed as an SK grade on the same site's SDS page. YUBASE-3 is one of the two named exceptions. Not stated in the archived NARMAK TRADE property sheet. Supersedes the brand-level SK Enmove page and the third-party SlideShare copy of SK Corporation's 2000 paper (slide 10), which agrees (2026-10 audit).
